text:
Alex Chen: opened a small docs PR to clarify nullable objects in the /v1/transformations request body. the example currently mixes omitted vs explicit `null` and it's causing confusion for SDK snippets
Priya Kapoor: link?
Alex Chen: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — changes: add explicit examples for (1) omitted `options`, (2) `options: null`, update OpenAPI schema to `nullable: true`, and add a Ruby SDK snippet showing how `nil` is encoded
Mike Torres: which field is the main pain point?
Alex Chen: the `options` object that can contain `prompt_overrides` and `cache_hint`. servers historically accepted missing or empty object; want to make nullable behavior explicit
Samira Lee: I noticed CI docs-lint is failing because example 2 has a trailing comma in the JSON block
Docs Bot: CI: docs-lint failed on PR #4821 — invalid JSON example at examples/transformations.md: line 42
Priya Kapoor: I can fix the trailing comma and update the Ruby snippet. can someone sanity-check the Ruby usage of `nil` vs `{}`?
Mike Torres: for our Ruby SDK, `nil` becomes `null` in JSON when using `to_json`, so snippet should be `options: nil` not `options: {}` if you want explicit null. I can paste a small example
Priya Kapoor: please do
Mike Torres: ```ruby
# Ruby example for explicit null
payload = {
  model: "rw-small-transformer",
  input: "Summarize...",
  options: nil
}
client.post('/v1/transformations', payload.to_json)
```
Alex Chen: perfect. I'll swap the JS snippet to show omission only, and add this Ruby example to show explicit null. also adding a short migration note: "If you previously relied on the server to treat missing `options` as empty object, please ensure your client sends `{}` or omitted field; sending `null` is accepted but may be interpreted differently by downstream processors."
Samira Lee: can you add a one-liner in the OpenAPI description too? that helps some SDK generators pick up the nullable semantics
Alex Chen: yes — I'll add `description: "options (nullable) — pass null to explicitly clear overrides"` in the schema and run `make docs-lint` locally
Priya Kapoor: updated PR: fixed trailing comma, added Ruby snippet, added OpenAPI description. also added a small example of request/response pair for clarity
Docs Bot: CI: docs-lint passed. Preview: https://deploy-preview-4821--docs.redwood.ai/en/reference/transformations
Alex Chen: awesome, thank you everyone. final ask: @Mike can you quick-check the wording of the migration note for runtime implications?
Mike Torres: looks good to me, :thumbsup: merge when green
Priya Kapoor: merging after a quick re-run of local tests. will tag the changelog entry
Alex Chen: thanks — will follow up with a short release note for the SDK team to be aware of the `nullable` change
Samira Lee: noted, I'll add a Jira ticket to track SDK release compatibility
Docs Bot: PR #4821 merged by Priya Kapoor at 1738202979
Alex Chen: :tada:
